If you want monthly release of the spend cap, we can set a monthly gate in our billing portal — please confirm preferred cadence and the month-by-month distribution (equal installments or frontloaded).

I've attached a provisional-po-template.xlsx that finance uses to stamp PO numbers. If everything looks good, I'll loop in finance to request the official PO and confirm the spend cap gating (monthly release settings).

Next steps I will take:
- Loop in Ben (billing) + Laura (vendor ops) to request official PO issuance.
- Hold provisional reference open for your tickets.

Let me know the monthly cadence and whether the setup fee should be invoiced immediately or against the first month.

Thanks — Tessa
